verdict.rationale: Viam's official CLI documents data export "in a variety of formats" and SQL/MQL queries over tabular or binary data with a `--destination` output path, so you can pull captured data out with first-party tooling. The evidence never names the formats, so it is unclear whether they are open, and nothing shows a complete export of everything (configs, datasets, models) or a documented offboarding path. missing for 10: named open export formats, evidence of bulk export covering all data types (machine configs, datasets, trained models), documented account exit/offboarding process, independent or hands-on corroboration of export.
